answer: For brown planthopper in paddy, first drain the water from your field for 3 to 4 days — the insects need humid conditions at the plant base. Do not add more urea now, because extra nitrogen makes the outbreak worse. Open small alleyways between rows so air can move. If you count more than 10 hoppers on a single hill, visit your Krishi Vigyan Kendra before spraying anything; they will confirm the right treatment.
